_comment: Config for readiness_check.py; copy to .claude/hooks/readiness.json. Delete a section you have not adopted (an absent section prints nothing). Paths are relative to the project directory. The recurring and ask_at_trigger entries are EXAMPLES: keep only the steps the owner named.

recurring.why: prunes skills and memory entries that no longer earn their context

ask_at_trigger.trigger: before pushing a landing that carries several commits (billed and owner-only: ask, never skip)
before pushing an edit to a skill or agent definition (billed: ask)
